description: This source file defines the StartCVDAction class and related functions in the orchestrator package for starting CVD (Cuttlefish Virtual Device) instances within the Android Cuttlefish project. It handles operation creation, execution, and the interaction with external CVD CLI commands.

classes.name: StartCVDAction
classes.description: Represents the action of starting a CVD instance with encapsulated request parameters, selector, paths, and CLI interface, managing its execution.

methods.name: NewStartCVDAction
methods.description: Constructor function that creates and initializes a new StartCVDAction based on provided options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Initiates the start operation asynchronously, returning an operation handle.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the actual CVD start process, optionally using a snapshot, and interacts with the CVD CLI.
